title: Hierarchy of wiring specificity, parallel descending-neuron screens and dimorphic circuit organization in whole-CNS Drosophila connectome simulations
description: GPU-accelerated whole-CNS leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) simulator, nine-level Maslov-Sneppen null-model hierarchy, K=486 Common-Random-Numbers virtual Split-GAL4 descending-neuron perturbation screen, closed-loop 3D NeuroMechFly v2 steering, and within-connectome fru/dsx double-dissociation suite across MaleCNS v1.0 and Female BANC v888.
